votes.quote: on motion by fortin and second by watters, the above minutes were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the requested variances for the replacement septic system at Marshall Park (100 Chestnut Street): offset to wetlands from 100 feet to 58 feet, groundwater offset from 4 feet to 3 feet, less than 4 feet of pervious material to 2.33 feet, and inlet and outlet tees less than 12 inches to 4 inches.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by watters, the board unanimously approved the requested variances. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the extension requested by Stella's (the minutes do not say what the extension covers).
votes.quote: the board voted to approve the extension. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve a one year extension of the septic permit at 1 Valley Road until February 14, 2023.
votes.quote: the board voted to approve the request for a one year extension until february 14, 2023.

votes.motion: Pass the Title 5 report for 1432 Lancaster Avenue on the condition that the well water be tested yearly (coliform bacteria, nitrates, nitrites and ammonia) and that the septic tank under the deck be made accessible.
votes.quote: after much discussion and on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the boar d voted to pass the title 5 report

votes.motion: Extend the septic permits for 441 Country Road and 205 Sunset Lane for one year from the date of the meeting, until March 21, 2023.
votes.quote: after discussion and motion by watters and second by fortin, the above septic permits were extended for one year
and seconded by jewell, the meeting was adjourned at 8:35 pm, all in favor.
